title: Tenyard
description: Workers, box runs and the process groups inside them (enojen/tenyard#46).

panels.title: In numbers (the whole cluster, in the selected time range)
Tasks
panels.description: Tasks that ran at least one tenbox command on a machine.

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Projects (repositories) whose tasks ran on a machine.

panels.title: Machine runs
panels.description: tenbox commands run on a machine: start, plan, approve, build, pr, close ...

panels.title: Agent hours
panels.description: Hours a Claude agent was running inside a machine run (from the process groups, known since 2026-11-06 15:00 UTC).

panels.title: Machine hours
panels.description: Hours of all machine runs added up (in 30 s steps).

panels.title: Most runs at once
panels.description: The most machine runs that were running at the same time.

panels.title: Workers opened
panels.description: Worker machines the autoscaler opened (and closed) for the runs.

panels.title: Machine cost
panels.description: The list price of every machine and task volume times the minutes it was up, summed. The bill counts started hours: see `tenbox-server costs`.

panels.title: Cost per task
panels.description: Machine cost divided by the tasks.

panels.title: Out of memory kills
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed because a run went over its memory.

panels.title: CPU hours
panels.description: CPU the machine runs used, in hours of one full core.

panels.title: Worker time with no run
panels.description: The share of the time a worker was up with no run on it: paid for and not used.

targets.expr: 1 - sum(sum_over_time((max by (node) (kube_node_labels{node=~"box-.*"}) and on (node) count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="tenbox"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="tenbox", phase="Running"}) == 1)))[$__range:$__interval])) / sum(sum_over_time(max by (node) (kube_node_labels{node=~"box-.*"})[$__range:$__interval]))

panels.title: 1 · Workers: which machines were up, how full, at what price
Workers up
panels.description: One line per machine of the cluster: green while it was up. tenbox-ci is the control plane and is always up; box-* are the workers the autoscaler opened for box runs. The server type is in brackets.

panels.title: Cost per hour (EUR)
panels.description: What the machines that are up cost per hour, stacked: the list price of each one. Hetzner bills every started hour; the exact paid euros are in `tenbox-server costs`.

panels.title: CPU used (% of the machine)
panels.description: How busy each machine's CPU was: 100 % = all its cores busy.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{id="/", instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (instance) label_copy(max by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="cpu"}), "node", "instance")

panels.title: Memory used (% of the machine)
panels.description: How full each machine's memory was, against what pods may use (allocatable: the machine's RAM less the system reserve). File cache included.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{id="/", instance=~"$node"}) / on (instance) label_copy(max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}), "node", "instance")

panels.title: Memory reserved by boxes (% of the machine)
panels.description: Each box reserves the RAM of its class when it starts (plan 1.5 GiB, build 2 GiB, heavy 3 GiB), used or not. A new box goes only to a machine with that much unreserved RAM; when no machine has it, a new worker opens and costs money. Reserved far above "Memory used" means RAM paid for and not used.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="tenbox", resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="tenbox", phase="Running"}) == 1)) / on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.title: 2 · Box runs: one tenbox command of a task on its machine
Box runs
panels.description: One row per box run in the time range: the task, the tenbox command (start, plan, build, close ...), the project, its class (plan, build, heavy), the machine, when it started, how long it ran (in 30 s steps), the highest memory it used, as a share of its class's limit, the CPU seconds it used and its OOM kills. Click a task to see the process groups of that run.

targets.expr: max by (pod, label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) (max_over_time(kube_pod_labels{namespace="tenbox", label_project=~"$project", label_task=~"$task", label_command=~"$command"}[$__range]))

max by (pod) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="tenbox", container="box"}[$__range])) / on (pod) max by (pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="tenbox", container="box", resource="memory"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Memory of each run
panels.description: Memory of the box over time, one line per run (hover for its name). Pick a task above to see only its runs.

targets.expr: max by (pod, label_task, label_command) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="tenbox", container="box", instance=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) max by (namespace, pod, label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="tenbox", label_project=~"$project", label_task=~"$task", label_command=~"$command"}))

panels.title: CPU of each run (cores)
panels.description: CPU of the box over time: 1 = one full core. A box has no CPU limit, so it takes what the machine has free.

targets.expr: max by (pod, label_task, label_command) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="tenbox", container="box", instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) max by (namespace, pod, label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="tenbox", label_project=~"$project", label_task=~"$task", label_command=~"$command"}))

panels.title: Waiting for CPU (% of the time)
panels.description: The share of time some process of the run waited for a free CPU (pressure stall information). Near 0 = CPU was enough; high = more CPU would make the run faster.

targets.expr: max by (pod, label_task, label_command) (rate(container_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{namespace="tenbox", container="box", instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) max by (namespace, pod, label_project, label_task, label_command, label_class) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="tenbox", label_project=~"$project", label_task=~"$task", label_command=~"$command"}))

panels.title: 3 · Inside the runs: what used the CPU and memory
CPU per process group (cores)
panels.description: Inside the selected runs, how much CPU each kind of process used, stacked: claude, the tenbox CLI, tests, tsc, lint, installs, git, services, procs and the rest (other).

panels.title: Memory per process group
panels.description: Inside the selected runs, the memory of each kind of process, stacked: heap and stacks, without the file cache.

panels.title: CPU seconds per group (whole time range)
panels.description: The CPU seconds each group used in the selected runs over the time range: where the CPU went.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (group) (max by (pod, group) (max_over_time(tenyard_procs_cpu_seconds_total{project=~"$project", task=~"$task", command=~"$command", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Memory peak per group (one run)
panels.description: The most memory each group held at once in any one of the selected runs: what sizes a class.
